trainer/31583-5.htm.text: Blacksmith Feynn: I, the great Feynn, am talented at augmenting items as well. Are you requesting something be augmented right now?

trainer/31583-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Feynn: Skill? What skill? Ha! My my... you are clueless, aren't you? You've come to the wrong place! Bwa ha ha! That's hilarious! You may grow a nice beard and shorten your height by half, you'll never be a successful Dwarf with a face like that! You crack me up, kid!

Q00072_SagaOfTheSwordMuse/2-01.htm.text: Blacksmith Feynn: Ha ha! So you're here for the teachings of Eva, eh? Hmm... OK, but it won't come cheap! Get it? What's in it for me? No, I don't want your money or gemstones... Nothing like that! I've got all of that kind of stuff I need, thanks... What can you offer the man who has everything?

Q00072_SagaOfTheSwordMuse/2-02.htm.text: Blacksmith Feynn: What good is a song without a beer? Bring me a Bitter Cold Beer from Chef Jonas in Goddard Castle Town... That would even make the squealing of a pig sound like a beautiful aria!

Q00072_SagaOfTheSwordMuse/2-03.htm.text: Blacksmith Feynn: Huh? Is that a beer?! Amazing! You really brought it! I thought you were just a weakling entertainer! I'm impressed! I guess if I live long enough, I'll see everything! You even brought snacks! You really take care of your customers, don't you? You passed the beer test with flying…

Q00072_SagaOfTheSwordMuse/2-04.htm.text: Blacksmith Feynn: Huh? Have you forgotten where the stone tablet is already? I told you, it's in the southern part of the Tower of Insolence. Got it? Do you have the Stone of Commune? Don't drop it on the way there! You have a long journey ahead. Be careful!

Q00072_SagaOfTheSwordMuse/2-05.htm.text: Blacksmith Feynn: You're really going to sing? This should be hilarious! Honestly, sometimes I just don't get you Elves! We Dwarves never listen to music sober! It's like eating pancakes without syrup! Have you ever tasted beer? From the moment it hits your tongue, a cold tingle shoots through you …

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
